name: mytrack-desktop
description: MyTrack as a desktop app for macOS and Windows, with its database stored on this computer.
author: PodUp

scripts.prepare-app: npm run build-server && npm run fetch-db
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build-server && node scripts/fetch-mariadb.mjs --os mac && node scripts/build-camera-helper.mjs && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build-server && node scripts/fetch-mariadb.mjs --os win && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:all: npm run build-server && node scripts/fetch-mariadb.mjs --os mac && node scripts/fetch-mariadb.mjs --os win && node scripts/build-camera-helper.mjs && electron-builder --mac --win

extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: MyTrack takes screenshots only while you switch Screenshots on.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The Screen recorder can add your microphone to a recording.
extendInfo.NSLocationUsageDescription: The IP locator can use this device's location when you ask it to.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: MyTrack takes a security photo when someone signs in or opens the app (shown in Login history).
